topic: Getting paid on time without losing the client

shorts.title: Set payment terms before you start work

scenes.text: Agreeing payment terms up front cuts down late payers, plain and simple.
Say you're a plumber quoting a bathroom refit: put deposit, progress payments and final due date in writing before you start.
Spell out accepted payment methods and the due date so there's no argument later.
If a client won't agree, offer options: a higher deposit, staged payments, or cash on completion.
For repeat late payers consider upfront or cash terms. Putting it in writing protects your cashflow and keeps the client relationship clear.

shorts.caption: Agree payment terms before starting work. Clear, written terms stop arguments and protect your cashflow.
